Fixed: TrickTakingScorer now reads state.TrumpSuit at scoring time so greedy AI handles TrumpCut and TrumpLed games correctly.
Fixed: Engine.Select now scans entire population for highest TotalFitness rather than only checking position 0 of SharedFitness sort

Fixed: NewNoveltyEngine and NewMAPElitesEngine now apply 'if config.Workers == 0 { config.Workers = runtime.NumCPU() }' at construction time, matching NewEngine. Smoke tested with -population 10 -generations 1 -algorithm hybrid (and mapelites) without -workers; both complete instead of hanging. Added regression tests in pkg/evolution/workers_default_test.go.

Fixed: tricktaking CheckEnd now returns -1 (not findWinner) when state.Turn >= MaxTurns and hands are non-empty. Behavior now matches shedding/rummy comments warning that scoring a hung game masks Tier1 timeout detection. Test added: TestCheckEndReturnsTimeoutAtMaxTurns.

Fixed: shedding/runner.go Setup now stores rng on state.RNG, and GenerateMoves recycles the discard pile (minus the top card) into the deck before falling through to MovePass when the deck is empty. Mirrors the rummy reshuffle pattern. Tests added: TestSetupStoresRNG, TestGenerateMovesReshufflesDiscardWhenDeckEmpty.

Fixed: applySpecialEffects now captures originActive at function entry, computes all victim/skip targets relative to that fixed origin, accumulates a single advance count, and applies state.NextPlayer once per resolved chain at the end. Stacked Skip+DrawTwo on a single card now penalizes origin+1 rather than origin+2. Test added: TestStackedSpecialsTargetOriginalNextPlayer (4-player setup).

Fixed: computeNovelty now stores per-skeleton behavior points alongside their owning *NoveltyIndividual and skips the current individual by pointer identity rather than filtering 'if d > 0'. Zero distances from other identical individuals are preserved, so converged clusters score Novelty=0 (penalizing duplication) instead of pulling distances from outliers. Test added: TestComputeNoveltyConvergedClusterScoresZero with NoveltyK+1 cluster members + 1 outlier.
fix(shedding): collect special-card effects and apply at most once

Already fixed by commit 7110687 (dd-xns). Tests in pkg/skeleton/shedding/runner_test.go: TestReverseFlipsDirectionWith3Players and TestReverseTwoPlayerActsAsSkip both pass. Direction field on GameState and direction-aware NextPlayer were added in that commit; applySpecialEffects already toggles Direction for all player counts. This bd issue is a duplicate.

Fixed: determineTrump now consumes the full pre-deal deck in both Runner.Setup and redealRound, so TrumpCut keeps a real suit even when HandSize*Players==52 empties the post-deal remainder. Regression tests TestTrumpCutAssignsTrumpEvenWhenDeckFullyDealt and TestTrumpCutRedealAssignsTrumpEvenWhenDeckFullyDealt added.

Fixed: computeGameArc now normalizes turn-length spread via coefficient of variation (stddev/mean) rather than raw variance. This makes the turn-score scale-invariant so a long-running rummy genome no longer trivially saturates the metric while a proportionally-spread short shedding genome scores near zero. CV saturates at ~0.4. Regression test TestGameArcTurnScoreIsScaleInvariant added.
